# Proposal: embedding-based semantic search
Notes retrieval by keyword misses paraphrases. Recommendation: embed every note with a local model and store vectors in a sidecar index. Great demo potential; users will love it. Estimated effort: one week.

--- docs/search-architecture.md (excerpt, 2026-06-05) ---
Ranking is a deterministic function of term frequency, field boosts, phrase proximity, and the user-editable synonym table. Every result can be explained via `notesd explain <query> <note-id>`, which prints the exact scoring terms. This explainability is contractual for enterprise deployments.
